hypothesis: Adopting Subjective Logic's opinion structure (belief + disbelief + uncertainty + base rate) as an optional refinement of tetravalent's 'U' state will give Demerzel calibrated uncertainty rather than the categorical 'Unknown', and will measurably improve predictive power on which artifacts are worth investing more evidence into. If it does not improve over plain U after 3 cycles, demote it — the same discipline hari applied to its Lie-algebra prior.

plan.description: Add an optional `subjective_logic` block to logic/tetravalent-state.schema.json with shape {belief: number, disbelief: number, uncertainty: number, base_rate: number} where belief+disbelief+uncertainty=1. Let new evolution entries opt in; do not migrate legacy entries. Track over 3 compound cycles whether SL-augmented assessments are better predictors of artifact effectiveness than plain T/F/U/C.
plan.success_criteria: Predictive lift > 0 on at least one of: which 'U' artifacts later become T (correctly anticipated by high SL-belief); which artifacts hit deprecation candidate status (anticipated by high SL-disbelief). After 3 cycles, the comparison is in.
risks: Complexity tax with no signal — apply hari's 'demote Lie' discipline mercilessly if SL adds no measurable lift
Base-rate calibration is hard — use empirical priors from existing evolution entries rather than inventing them
Constitutional change required — this is INNOVATIVE Kaizen per the compound-cycle skill, needs explicit human approval before any persona starts emitting SL opinions

check.evidence: Plan never started (134 days; target 2026-06-15). Its measurement design depends on three compound cycles scoring SL-augmented evolution assessments, and no compound cycle has updated state/evolution since 2026-07-29, so the lift could not be measured even if the schema block were added. The 'categorical Unknown' gap it targets is smaller than the plan assumed: Demerzel adopted hexavalent logic on 2026-03-24 (logic/hexavalent-state.schema.json), whose P and D already grade partial belief, and the substrate audit replays beliefs through hari. hari's own evaluation pins its shipped experimental arm to RecencyDecay, not SubjectiveLogic (hari docs/research/2026-07-30-ix-eval-interim-assessment.md, §1).

act.rationale: The plan's own discipline applies: no measured lift, no promotion. Nothing was adopted, so no persona emits SL opinions and the human-approval gate on adoption was never reached. This record is closed as abandoned. Merging the change that records it is the human approval for closing it.
next_steps: Reopen only with a measurement that can run: a replay of state/beliefs through hari comparing SL opinions against hexavalent P/U/D on beliefs later re-evaluated.
